originalTitle: Ethiopia's Virgin Mary festival in Tigray cancelled over drone strike fears
title: A Special Day is Postponed for Safety in Ethiopia
content:
Hello, hello, young adventurers! It's your friendly news reporter from amazing Africa, ready to share some important news with you! My name is Reporter Razi, and I love telling stories about our big, beautiful continent.

What is a Festival?

Do you know what a festival is? It's like a really big, happy party! People come together to celebrate something special. Maybe it's a happy holiday, or a good harvest of food, or to remember important people. Festivals often have music, dancing, yummy food, and lots of laughter. Everyone wears their best clothes and meets their friends and family. It's a time for joy and togetherness!

A Special Festival in Ethiopia

Now, imagine a very special festival that happens in a beautiful country called Ethiopia. Ethiopia is a big land in Africa, full of amazing history and kind people. This festival is called the Virgin Mary festival. It's a very old and important day for many people, especially women. It’s like a super special Women's Day where everyone celebrates and prays. It happens in a place in Ethiopia called Tigray. Tigray is a region with lovely mountains and old churches. People travel from all over to be together.

Who is Mary?

Did you know? Mary is a very special lady for many people around the world, especially for Christians. She is known for being kind and loving. This festival is a way for people to show their love and respect for her. It’s a time for thinking about peace and goodness.

Why This Festival is Super Important

This festival is extra special for women. It's a day when they can gather, share stories, pray, and feel strong together. They wear colourful dresses and sing beautiful songs. It’s a time for grandmothers, mothers, and daughters to spend time with each other. They learn from each other and make new friends. It helps them feel like a big, happy family. Imagine all the women laughing and talking and sharing food. It's a really wonderful sight!

Sad News: No Festival This Year

But sometimes, grown-ups have to make very difficult decisions to keep everyone safe. And so, this year, the big, happy Virgin Mary festival in Tigray will not happen. Everyone was looking forward to it so much. Many women had planned their trips and prepared their special clothes. But for now, they can’t gather. It's a bit sad, right? When something you look forward to is cancelled. But there's a very important reason why.

Why No Festival? Worries in the Sky

The grown-ups who look after everyone decided it wasn't safe enough. They are worried about "things flying in the sky." These flying things can sometimes be dangerous. When there are worries about safety, it's always best to be super careful. They want to make sure no one gets hurt. That's why they said, "Let's wait until it's safe for everyone to celebrate."

What are These "Flying Things"? A Little Explanation

You might be wondering, what are these "flying things"? Sometimes, they are called "drones." Did you know? A drone is like a small aeroplane or helicopter, but it doesn't have a person flying inside it. Someone flies it from the ground with a remote control. They can be used for fun, like taking cool pictures from up high, or for delivering things. But sometimes, in places where there are problems, they can be used for serious things that can make people unsafe. The grown-ups in Tigray are worried about these kinds of serious flying things.

Safety Comes First, Always!

Our grown-ups, like our parents and teachers, always want to keep us safe. Safety is the most important thing. Imagine if you were going to a big playground, but there was a big storm coming. Your parents would say, "Not today, honey. It's not safe." It's a bit like that with the festival. It’s about protecting everyone who would come to the celebration. They want to make sure no one feels scared or gets hurt.

How People Feel and Hope for Next Time

It's okay to feel sad or disappointed when things like this happen. Many women in Tigray will feel that way. They will miss their special day together. But it’s also important to remember that this decision was made out of love and care. It means people care deeply about each other's well-being. Everyone hopes that next year, everything will be calm and safe. Then, the festival can come back, bigger and happier than ever before!

Did You Know?

* **Ethiopia's Calendar:** Did you know that Ethiopia has its own special calendar? It's a bit different from the one most of the world uses! So, their holidays sometimes fall on different days. * **Oldest Country:** Ethiopia is one of the oldest countries in the world! It has a history that goes back thousands and thousands of years. * **Coffee Time!** Did you know that coffee was first discovered in Ethiopia? So every time you see a grown-up drinking coffee, you can think of Ethiopia! * **Peace is Important:** Peace means being safe and happy, without any fighting or worries. When we have peace, we can have all our fun festivals and be together.

Let's Think About Peace

This news reminds us how important peace is. When there is peace, everyone can play, learn, and celebrate without any fear. Let's all hope for peace in Tigray and everywhere in Africa. When we are kind to each other and help each other, we are helping to build a peaceful world. So, let's keep being kind, young friends, and hope for happy festivals for everyone soon! Thank you for listening to your friendly African news reporter!
summary: A special festival for women in Ethiopia called the Virgin Mary festival has been cancelled this year because grown-ups want to keep everyone safe from things flying in the sky.
whyMatters: It's important because festivals bring people joy and community, and we hope everyone can be safe to celebrate again soon.
